invalid_explore_case.why: propose_cases got a case without a name and one or two changes, an unknown engine, a change that is not a finite value with its range and source, or an investment case without a complete study intake. Nothing was admitted; the assistant fixes the proposal.

explore_case_cap.why: A run explores at most four cases (AI-558): a fifth, in this proposal or with the cases already admitted, was refused. Nothing was admitted.

explore_change_cap.why: A case changes at most two things (AI-558); a third change was refused. Nothing was admitted.

explore_case_name.why: A case name was empty, too long, not plain text, or already used in this run. Nothing was admitted.

explore_not_a_lever.why: A case changed something that is not one of the profile's explore levers (or, for an investment case, not a row of the decision study's ledger). The question is never changed; nothing was admitted.

explore_value_out_of_range.why: A case value lies outside its range, or its range lies outside the lever's bounds or is in another unit (refused, not converted). Nothing was admitted.

explore_range_unsourced.why: A change's range cites no source the harness can check: the lever's profile bounds, a research range row the user confirmed with exactly these bounds, or the decision study's sourced ledger range. A range from the model's own text is never a source; nothing was admitted.

explore_solve_budget.why: The proposed cases need more solves than the run's envelope has left. Nothing was admitted; the assistant proposes fewer cases or the user raises the solve budget.

explore_not_in_turn.why: propose_cases was called outside an explore turn of a harness run, or by a process that no longer holds the run's lease. Nothing was admitted.
